ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white cubes with golden-brown browned edges and crisp-looking surfaces, roughly 2-3 cm pieces, some with flat cut faces, sitting in the upper left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Golden-yellow grains, fine and fluffy, granular texture with scattered darker specks, spread in a mound about 9 cm across on the right side of the plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Sliced pinkish-brown meat with a rosy red center and browned seared outer edges, fibrous grain, moderately moist, cut into strips about 1 cm thick and 6 cm long, resting on a bed of greens | 90
ITEM 4 | Dark green leafy greens, some large wilted leaves with ribbed texture and small curled leaves, scattered over the meat and at the upper right edge | 25
ITEM 5 | Yellow summer squash slices, bright yellow skin with pale flesh, about 0.5 cm thick half-moon and wedge pieces, slightly glossy, arranged in a fan at the lower left of the plate | 45
ITEM 6 | Green zucchini slices with dark green skin and pale green flesh, thin rounds and wedges, slightly glossy, mixed with the yellow squash at lower left | 40
ITEM 7 | Roasted golden-brown potato chunks with crisp, caramelized surfaces and soft pale interiors, about 3 cm pieces, clustered at upper right beside the meat | 60
